name: Spire Ledger
author: MokoGuy (fork of Damage Charts by zaxnyd)
description: Co-op stats for Slay the Spire 2: who dealt the damage (Poison and Doom credited to whoever applied them), effects applied, block given, cards and energy, per fight and per run; an end-of-run recap with each player's badges; a Ledger screen in the Compendium with your run history and records; and a one-click import of your normal progress into the modded profile. Plus the Damage Charts forecast and combat breakdown (hotkey C).
